doubts: The page describes a network of walking tracks in Balls Clearing Scenic Reserve (10 to 40 min) without naming any individual track, and gives no start, end or shape for any track, so kind is network and no ways are recorded. The reserve entrance on Pakaututu Road is taken as an access point, ref F1 (the only road end, where Balls Clearing Track meets Pakaututu Road); the text does not explicitly say the tracks start at that feature, so this ref is inferred. The onto field is null because the text does not say which track the entrance joins.
